findings.title: "Silence notifications" in the new list does nothing: the drawer needs a ruler rule the list no longer has
findings.body: `GrafanaRuleListItem` now renders `<RuleActionsButtons promRule={rule} .../>` with no `rule` (ruler) prop. `AlertRuleMenu` still shows "Silence notifications" because `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` returns `canSilence` (`useAbilities.ts:323`). Clicking it calls `setShowSilenceDrawer(true)`. The drawer is only rendered under `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer`, and `rule` is `undefined` here. So the menu item is visible and enabled and the click silently does nothing. The new test only asserts that the item exists (`GrafanaGroupLoader.test.tsx:194`), not that it works. `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` takes `rulerRule: RulerGrafanaRuleDTO` and only reads `grafana_alert.uid` (`SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer.tsx:21`). Either make the drawer accept the uid / a `GrafanaPromRuleDTO`, or hide the item until it can work.

findings.title: Delete and Pause are gated on `rulerRule`, so they vanish from the ruler-less list menu even though abilities allow them
findings.body: The PR computes `canDelete` and `canPause` from the Grafana prom abilities (lines 83 and 87). The render conditions still require a ruler rule: `canDelete && rulerRule` (line 165) and `canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` (line 123). In the new list view `rulerRule` is always `undefined`, so Delete and Pause never render for Grafana rules there. Before, both appeared for users with permission. The prom-based delete/pause abilities are dead code on the only path that passes only `promRule`. Users lose delete and pause from the list with no error. Make `handleDelete`, `MenuItemPauseRule` and the delete modal work from the prom rule and the group identifier. Or, if this is intentionally deferred, don't compute the abilities and say so.

findings.title: With `skipToken`, `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` reports Duplicate as supported, so `AlertRuleMenu` can enable Duplicate for rules the ruler path rejects
findings.body: For `skipToken`, `rule` is `undefined`. Then `isPluginProvided` is `false`, `loading` is `false` (`useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable` returns `loading: false` when `!rule`), and `MaybeSupported` is `AlwaysSupported`. So `Duplicate` becomes `toAbility(true, getRulesPermissions('grafana').create)`: supported, and allowed for any user with the global `AlertingRuleCreate`. `AlertRuleMenu` ORs this with the ruler ability (`AlertRuleMenu.tsx:91-92`). Cloud and data-source rules, and plugin-provided rules, therefore get a Duplicate item whenever the user holds the Grafana create permission. The ruler path would report them unsupported (no ruler, plugin-provided). Update, Delete, Pause and Export don't leak, because `isEditable`, `isRemovable` and `isAlertingRule` are false for `undefined`. Return all-`NotSupported` abilities from `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` when `rule` is `undefined`. The `RulesTable` tests miss this because the hooks are mocked.

findings.title: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` no longer treats federated rule groups as immutable, and `fromCombinedRule` can now throw
findings.body: The old `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` (checks `group.source_tenants`, `rules.ts:373`). Both its `immutableRule` and the Update, Delete and Pause abilities depended on it. The deprecated wrapper now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hard-codes `isFederated = false` (line 245). The legacy list (`RulesTable`, `RuleDetailsButtons` via `useAlertRuleAbility`) therefore offers Edit and Delete on federated Mimir groups, where it used to disable them. `ExistingRuleEditor`, `RulesGroup` and `RuleViewer` still check `isFederatedRuleGroup`, so they disagree with these abilities. Keep the `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` check in the wrapper path, or pass an `isFederated` flag through. Separately, the wrapper now calls `groupIdentifier.fromCombinedRule`, which calls `getDatasourceAPIUid` and throws `Datasource "x" not found` (`datasource.ts:299-306`) when the data source is unknown. The old code only called `getRulesSourceName`. That is why `RuleDetails.test.tsx` needed `mimirDs`.

findings.title: View link no longer carries `returnTo`, so Back from the rule page loses the list state
findings.body: The removed `GrafanaRuleListItem` built `href` with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo })` using `createReturnTo()`. The new one links to `/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view` with no `returnTo`. The sibling `DataSourceRuleListItem.tsx:36-42` still passes it. `RuleViewer.tsx:96` reads it with `useReturnTo('/alerting/list')`. From the Grafana list (filters, search, page), the rule page's back target now falls back to the unfiltered `/alerting/list`. Restore `createReturnTo()` in the href.

findings.title: Recording rules lose Export (and Pause/Restore) in the prom-based abilities
findings.body: The ruler version used `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule = rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)`, which includes recording rules. For `ModifyExport`, `Pause`, `Restore` and `DeletePermanently`, the prom version uses `isAlertingRule = prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`. A Grafana recording rule in the new list can no longer be exported from the menu, though it could before. The comment at line 301 says "All GrafanaPromRuleDTO rules are Grafana-managed", which matches `prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule`, not the variable used. Use `prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)` for those four abilities and keep `isAlertingRule` only for Silence, as `useCanSilence` does. A stray `// duplicate` comment at line 289 should also go.

findings.title: Doc comments still describe Ruler loading; `operation` prop and Creating/Deleting states are now unused
findings.body: The JSDoc says "Loads an evaluation group from Prometheus and Ruler endpoints" (line 25) and the prop comment says "Ruler response might contain different number of rules" (line 19). The component now only queries Prometheus. `GrafanaRuleListItem` still accepts `operation` (`GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx:22`), but no caller passes it any more. The "Creating" and "Deleting" indicators and `RuleOperationListItem` usage for Grafana groups are gone. Update the comments and drop the unused prop, or note that the indicators were removed on purpose.

findings.title: Menu test pins the missing Delete/Pause items and ignores the Silence click
findings.body: The test grants `AlertingRuleDelete`, `AlertingRuleUpdate` and folder update/delete access (lines 48-62) and defines `ui.menuItems.delete` (line 42), then asserts exactly 4 menu items. Delete and Pause are absent, and the exact-count assertion makes that regression the expected behaviour. The comment "all 4 menu actions should be available" hides it. No test clicks Silence to check the drawer opens. The "should render More button" test (lines 85-102) only asserts the button exists, which the later tests already cover. After fixing the Delete/Pause/Silence findings, assert Delete is present and that Silence opens the drawer.

contracts.action: New list renders Grafana rules from the Prometheus response only and builds row actions from `promRule`
contracts.equivalent_path: Removed `GrafanaRuleListItem` in GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx (ruler + prom), and DataSourceRuleListItem.tsx for the data-source list
contracts.before_after: Before: href had `returnTo`, actions got `rule={rulerRule}`, and Delete, Pause and the Silence drawer all worked from the ruler rule. After: no `returnTo`, and `rule` is undefined, so ruler-gated menu items and the silence drawer never render.
contracts.visible_effect: Row shows the Edit link and a More menu. Silence is visible but its click is a no-op. Delete and Pause are missing. Back from the rule page goes to the unfiltered list.
contracts.failure_mode: All silent: no error and no log. Only the unmappable-identifier case logs a warning and renders nothing.

contracts.action: Abilities for prom-only Grafana rules, with `skipToken` for non-Grafana rules
contracts.before_after: Before: Duplicate and the other abilities came only from the ruler path, where support depends on ruler availability, plugin origin and provenance. After: the prom path is OR'ed in, and for `skipToken` it still reports Duplicate as supported.
contracts.visible_effect: Duplicate can appear in the menu of cloud, data-source or plugin rules for a user with the Grafana create permission.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent over-permissive UI. The server still enforces access, but the user is offered an action the ruler path rejected.

contracts.action: Provenance read from the Prometheus rule (`provenance` added to the DTO) to mark a rule immutable
contracts.before_after: Before: provenance came from the ruler rule. After: it comes from the prom response. The backend `Rule` struct serialises `provenance`, and `toRuleGroup` fills it from `provenanceRecords`.
contracts.visible_effect: Provisioned rules are shown as non-editable in the list.
contracts.failure_mode: If the provenance lookup fails, the backend sets an error on the response, and the UI then has no provenance data.

contracts.action: Removed ruler prefetch and the ruler group query from the Grafana list
contracts.before_after: Before: each group fetched its ruler group in addition to the prom group, and a ruler error gated rendering. After: only the prom group is fetched, with 20s polling. A Prometheus error shows the Alert only when no data is cached.
contracts.visible_effect: Fewer requests. The Creating/Deleting transitional rows are gone.
contracts.failure_mode: If polling fails after a first success, stale data stays on screen with no error.

summary:
The new Grafana rule list works from the Prometheus response alone, but the menu code still depends on a ruler rule that is no longer passed. That breaks several actions.

- **Silence:** the menu item shows, but clicking it does nothing, because the drawer needs a ruler rule.
- **Delete and Pause:** both disappear from the list menu.
- **Duplicate:** with `skipToken`, the prom abilities report it as supported, so it can show on cloud and plugin rules.
- **Federated groups:** the deprecated `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` wrapper no longer treats them as immutable.
- **View link:** it drops `returnTo`, so Back from the rule page loses the list filters.
- **Recording rules:** they lose Export under the prom abilities.
- **Tests:** the new menu test pins the missing Delete and Pause items instead of catching them.

I read all 14 files and spot-checked callers and the backend `provenance` field. I did not run anything.
